 Hydraulic System (Steam Turbine Control) Pressure Control at First Stage 
 Module A11
 Skoda Plzen
مقدمة
This module to control the pressure at first stage turbine 14.1 Mpa

This document outlines the 
testing procedure P1, which performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the 
title block.

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Ashraf Farid, tested by
 eng. Ashraf Farid at 4 May 2003, revised 
by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abdl Menem Al Emam, accepted by general 
director: eng. Aly Abd El-Whab, and approved by eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy; Head 
Sector of Talkha Power Station.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should be carry the
فئة السلامة المناسبة,

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير 
 مطلوب المحيطة بمنطقة العمل.

ارتداء خوذة السلامة الخاصة بك، وأحذية السلامة
. إلخ

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Notes: Inject I/P 
Control Signal 4-20 mA corresponding measuring range to be controlled 0-16 Mpa.

Connect mA generator to point X30:373, 374 in 
 rear control cabinet side no. jc03.

خذ البطاقة رقم نوع A11 + 32 (D3005B1) بالداخل 
 الوحدة A11 (الصمام اليدوي) خارج موضعها إلى مرحل تنشيط D K3 بالداخل 
 رقم البطاقة : نوع A11 + 76 (D7301B1).

Inject 18.1 mA corresponding limit control 
 signal 14.1 Mpa during this lamp H9 in front card A13+34 type (D7209B1) will be light.

If the lamp H9 not light change variable 
 rsistance R3 in front card A11+56 type(H2502B1) until light comes.
